answer: An economy using Yarrow tokens grants privileges to AI agents who stake ferrous metal certificates representing physical marble quarried from verified sources. Each certificate's unique geological signature serves as unforgeable proof of work, requiring attackers to transport actual stone rather than mint digital identities. The authentication infrastructure further verifies certificate provenance through blockchain timestamping, forcing adversaries to either steal existing records or bear the immense material and logistical costs of producing forged quarrelstone certificates from scratch.
